name: Azure Retail Prices API - ND96isr H200 v5 (eastus2, westus2)
notes: Same API, productName eq 'Virtual Machines NDsrH200v5 Series'. ND96isr H200 v5 (8x H200): on-demand $84.80/instance-hour = $10.60/H200 in eastus2 and westus2; Reservation $407,526/h (1yr) and $1,109,592/h (3yr); Low Priority $16.96 in eastus2. Spot is published at exactly $84.80 in eastus2/westus2 - identical to on-demand, i.e. Azure currently quotes NO spot discount on H200 v5, which is unusual and is itself the scarcity signal. westus3 lists $110.24 on-demand, usgovvirginia $106.00. The Azure pricing web page shows no price at all for this series, so the API is the only source. filter URL: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices?$filter=serviceName%20eq%20'Virtual%20Machines'%20and%20productName%20eq%20'Virtual%20Machines%20NDsrH200v5%20Series'
